summary: Korea Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) filed a Form 6-K disclosing an arbitration initiated by its unit, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power (KHNP), at the Korean Commercial Arbitration Board seeking ~$1.1 billion over an operational support services contract for the UAE nuclear plant. The amount is 3.37% of KEPCO's equity. KEPCO will defend itself. No special situation (acquisition, divestiture, activist, restructuring, etc.) is present; this is a routine legal disclosure.
